method: 20+1 source-page PNGs rendered from the original public-domain scans at 1800px for all ten outlier day prayers. Reviewed original printed prayer wording against extant V4 English bodies and matched OCR anomalies. Data records editorial correction status, not a blanket full original-print edition certificate.
sourcePageIndexBasis: PDF pages use zero-based indices; printed page ranges are printed Arabic page labels in the volume.
